subtitle: Blizzard Character Intelligence & Gear Comparison
changes: Added Character Intelligence, an independent responsive studio using existing Blizzard public profile and equipment endpoints through the Cloudflare gateway.
Compare two Retail characters by region, realm slug and name, including their equipment slots, item IDs and reported item levels.
Added optional JSON snapshot export and direct official item API research links; comparisons never infer missing items or true equipment power from item level alone.
Character Intelligence reads public API information only and does not access private Battle.net sessions or alter browser-saved progression.
Preserved v7.9.2 PC/mobile guides and existing studio JavaScript; Addon Nexus remains a separate v8.0 preview.
Live character result testing still requires players with public Blizzard records; no broad performance benchmark is claimed.
